raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: "dttlib"
  version: "0.11.3"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://git.ligo.org/cds/software/cr_tools/dttlib/-/archive/${{ version }}/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4f8412988b5eef445ed499e816b204d0298d879b525b6aaa3ff0df5b694c8acd

build:
  skip: 
    - win
    - match(python, "==3.14")
    - osx and x86_64 and match(python, "==3.12")

    #error_overlinking: true
    #error_overdepending: true
  number: 0
    # ignore_run_exports:
    #   - libclang13
    #   - zstd
      # run_exports:
      #   - if: osx
      #     then:
      #       - libosxunwind

  #script_env:
  #  - RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-lunwind  # [osx and arm64]

requirements:
  build:
    - "${{ compiler('c') }}"
    - "${{ stdlib('c') }}"
    - "${{ compiler('cxx') }}"
    - "${{ compiler('rust') }}"
      #   - if: osx
      #     then:
      #       - libosxunwind
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - make
    - pkg-config
      #- ruff
    - maturin
    - cmake
      #- libpython-static
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - "python"
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - libclang
      else:
        - "python"
  host:
    - libcurl
    - maturin
    - gds-sigp
    - libxml2
    - nds2-client
    - pip
    - rapidjson
    - zstd
    - if: build_platform == target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - libclang
      else:
        - python
  run:
    - python
    - gds-sigp

tests:
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    files:
      source:
        - test_dttlib.py
    script:
      content:
        - export NDSSERVER="nds.ligo.caltech.edu:31200" && pytest
      env:
        NDSSERVER: "nds.ligo.caltech.edu:31200"

about:
  homepage: https://git.ligo.org/cds/software/cr_tools/dttlib
  repository: https://git.ligo.org/cds/software/cr_tools/dttlib.git
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - COPYING
    - COPYING-GPL-3
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  summary: Core library for advanced LIGO frequency domain diagnostics tool

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - evonreis
